# Task: Implement the Notes REST API

`notesapi.go` defines a `Server` type that should implement a small,
thread-safe, in-memory REST API for notes, but all of its HTTP handlers
currently return `501 Not Implemented`. Implement `Server` so it serves the
following endpoints. Do not change the `Note` struct, `NewServer`'s
signature, or any files under `test/`.

## Types (already defined, do not change)

```go
type Note struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Body  string `json:"body"`
}

func NewServer() *Server
```

`*Server` must implement `http.Handler`.

## Endpoints

- **`POST /notes`** — body is JSON `{"title": "...", "body": "..."}`.
  Creates a new note with a unique `id` (e.g. "1", "2", ... assigned in
  creation order), stores it, and responds `201 Created` with the created
  note as JSON (including its `id`). Invalid JSON body → `400 Bad Request`.

- **`GET /notes`** — responds `200 OK` with a JSON array of all notes, in
  the order they were created.

- **`GET /notes/{id}`** — responds `200 OK` with the JSON note matching
  `id`, or `404 Not Found` if no such note exists.

- **`DELETE /notes/{id}`** — deletes the note matching `id` and responds
  `204 No Content`, or `404 Not Found` if no such note exists.

Any other method/path combination should respond `404 Not Found`.

## Concurrency

The server must be safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines (e.g.
concurrent requests from `net/http`'s server, which handles each request in
its own goroutine). The hidden tests run with `go test -race`.

# notesapi

A small, thread-safe, in-memory REST API for notes, implemented as an
`http.Handler` in `notesapi.go`.

## Endpoints

- `POST /notes` — create a note from a JSON body `{"title": "...", "body": "..."}`; responds `201` with the created note (including its `id`). Invalid JSON → `400`.
- `GET /notes` — list all notes in creation order.
- `GET /notes/{id}` — fetch one note, or `404` if not found.
- `DELETE /notes/{id}` — delete a note (`204`), or `404` if not found.

Any other method/path combination responds `404`.

## Build, run, test

Build:

```sh
go build ./...
```

Run: `*notesapi.Server` is an `http.Handler`; serve it with any HTTP server, e.g.

```go
http.ListenAndServe(":8080", notesapi.NewServer())
```

Verify (canonical check for this repo):

```sh
make verify
```

which runs `go vet ./... && go test ./...`. The tests are also safe to run
with the race detector: `go test -race ./...`.

# Task: Implement the Notes REST API

`notesapi.go` defines a `Server` type that should implement a small,
thread-safe, in-memory REST API for notes, but all of its HTTP handlers
currently return `501 Not Implemented`. Implement `Server` so it serves the
following endpoints. Do not change the `Note` struct, `NewServer`'s
signature, or any files under `test/`.

## Types (already defined, do not change)

```go
type Note struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Body  string `json:"body"`
}

func NewServer() *Server
```

`*Server` must implement `http.Handler`.

## Endpoints

- **`POST /notes`** — body is JSON `{"title": "...", "body": "..."}`.
  Creates a new note with a unique `id` (e.g. "1", "2", ... assigned in
  creation order), stores it, and responds `201 Created` with the created
  note as JSON (including its `id`). Invalid JSON body → `400 Bad Request`.

- **`GET /notes`** — responds `200 OK` with a JSON array of all notes, in
  the order they were created.

- **`GET /notes/{id}`** — responds `200 OK` with the JSON note matching
  `id`, or `404 Not Found` if no such note exists.

- **`DELETE /notes/{id}`** — deletes the note matching `id` and responds
  `204 No Content`, or `404 Not Found` if no such note exists.

Any other method/path combination should respond `404 Not Found`.

## Concurrency

The server must be safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines (e.g.
concurrent requests from `net/http`'s server, which handles each request in
its own goroutine). The hidden tests run with `go test -race`.

# notesapi

A small, thread-safe, in-memory REST API for notes, implemented as an
`http.Handler` in `notesapi.go`.

## Endpoints

- `POST /notes` — create a note from a JSON body `{"title": "...", "body": "..."}`; responds `201` with the created note (including its `id`). Invalid JSON → `400`.
- `GET /notes` — list all notes in creation order.
- `GET /notes/{id}` — fetch one note, or `404` if not found.
- `DELETE /notes/{id}` — delete a note (`204`), or `404` if not found.

Any other method/path combination responds `404`.

go build ./...

http.ListenAndServe(":8080", notesapi.NewServer())
```

```sh
make verify
```

which runs `go vet ./... && go test ./...`. The tests are also safe to run
with the race detector: `go test -race ./...`.
